source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 모두 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently freeze a complex yet physically plausible photographic test scene before downstream project data: two visibly separate adults perform one precise, immediately readable hand-to-hand object transfer, while the attachment supplies visible adult appearance guidance for only one subject.
subject: Exactly two unmistakably separate adults occupy opposite thirds of the frame. Adult A, the giver on the left, has long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, a calm neutral expression, steady object-directed gaze, and a dark wrap-style upper garment beneath an open transparent rain cape; these visible cues alone are guided by the attachment. Adult B, the receiver on the right, is visibly distinct through close-cropped pale blond hair, clear round protective glasses, a bright saffron waterproof coat, and slate trousers. Each adult has an individually readable head, torso, arms, hands, silhouette, and separate footing.
setting: A vast tiled subterranean water reservoir at blue hour, with repeating pale ceramic columns beneath a vaulted ceiling, ankle-deep mirror-like water, a narrow black water channel between two dry square granite stepping platforms, distant low mist, cool cyan dawn shafts from two round ceiling grates, and a few rust-red pipes high in the background. Adult A stands on the left platform and Adult B on the right, with open air and visible background separating their torsos.
event: Adult A gives one large lit amber hurricane lantern left-to-right to Adult B across the water gap. The lantern is upright and fully suspended between them, with its broad continuous steel bail, amber glass, cage, and circular base entirely visible. At the decisive overlapping-contact phase, Adult A's right thumb and first two fingertips open from the near-left crest of the bail while Adult A's left hand remains visibly open and empty beside the hip. Adult B's left hand closes firmly around the far-right half of the same bail and Adult B's right palm cups the complete underside of the base. Both gazes converge on the lantern, making the release, receipt, direction, and single shared object immediately readable.
visual_priorities: The first read is a left-to-right transfer of one suspended lantern, proven simultaneously by Adult A's releasing fingertips, Adult B's firm two-point receiving grip, and both object-directed gazes.

Exactly two adults remain unmistakably separate through opposite-third placement, distinct silhouettes and clothing, separate granite platforms, open background between torsos, and a visible water gap.
The single lantern is complete and continuous from bail to base, with every wrist, palm, finger, and plausible contact point sharply visible against contrasting backgrounds.
The medium-wide framing preserves both heads, torsos, elbows, all four hands, the entire lantern, and the nearest edges of both platforms.
Adult A uses only visible adult appearance cues from the attachment, while Adult B remains visually distinct through hair shape, eyewear, silhouette, and saffron clothing.
Cool cyan ceiling light, warm amber lantern light, consistent reflections, realistic anatomy, tactile wet surfaces, and restrained film grain establish a physically coherent documentary photograph.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a landscape 3:2 cinematic documentary editorial photograph of a blue-hour subterranean reservoir handoff. The vast physically plausible chamber has repeating pale ceramic columns beneath a vaulted ceiling, ankle-deep mirror-like water, a narrow black water channel between two dry square granite stepping platforms, restrained distant low mist, cool cyan dawn shafts from two round ceiling grates, and a few rust-red pipes high in the background. Frame exactly two unmistakably separate adults in a chest-height, medium-wide environmental two-shot from mid-thigh with generous headroom, using a natural 40 mm full-frame-equivalent perspective. Adult A stands alone on the left platform as giver. The attachment guides only Adult A's visible adult appearance: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, calm neutral expression, steady object-directed gaze, understated makeup, and a dark wrap-style upper garment beneath an open transparent rain cape. Adult B stands alone on the right platform as receiver, visibly distinct through close-cropped pale blond hair, clear round protective glasses, a bright saffron waterproof coat, and slate trousers. Open air, pale columns, and the water gap clearly separate their heads, torsos, arms, and silhouettes. Adult A gives the lantern left-to-right to Adult B. Show one large lit amber hurricane lantern suspended between them, upright in open air and centered over the water gap, with the complete broad steel bail, dark cage, amber glass, and circular base visible. Capture the decisive overlapping-contact phase: Adult A's right fingertips opening from the left crest of the bail, with the thumb and first two fingertips visibly releasing, while Adult A's left hand is fully visible, open, empty, and held beside the hip. Adult B's left hand is fully closed around the far-right half of the same continuous bail, and Adult B's right palm visibly cups and bears the complete underside of the circular base. Both adults look at the lantern. Their releasing and receiving grips, the unsupported upright object, and the stable left-to-right geometry make the handoff instantly legible. Place Adult A in the left third, Adult B in the right third, and the entire lantern plus every contact point in the clear center third. Preserve both heads, torsos, elbows, wrists, palms, fingers, the complete lantern, and both nearest platform edges in sharp focus. Cool cyan side light separates the outer silhouettes; warm practical amber lantern light reveals the inner forearms, fingers, steel bail, and base; pale tile, dark recesses, glow, and black water provide clean tonal separation around every hand. Render natural human anatomy, consistent reflections, realistic skin and wet-tile texture, subtle filmic contrast, preserved shadow detail, and fine high-ISO grain as a believable real photograph.
